question: When a number becomes a PDF and leaves the building, is it still right — and is it still what the database holds?
method: Read every document resolver and both renderers, then measured each claim against live dev rows. No finding here is inferred from code alone.
what_works: One resolver per document type produces a normalized PrintableDocument; both renderers consume the same model, so preview and download stay in step on structure, grouping and subtotals.
Display toggles show_bank_details / show_notes / show_tax_summary / show_signatories / show_contact_footer are all honoured (normalize applies four, both renderers gate on showContactFooter).
Empty-field, empty-section, empty-column and empty-table suppression all behave as documented, including the 0-and-false-are-printable rule.
Print CSS is present and correct on InvoicePDFScreen, QuotationPDFScreen, ExpenseFileView and PrintableDocumentHtml.
downloadInvoicePDF and printInvoicePDF share one blob, so the printed page is byte-identical to the downloaded file.

findings.title: Company Settings does not control the documents
findings.cause: applyBrandedDesign() runs after the resolver has normalized the document and unconditionally replaces contactFooter with the hardcoded BRANDED_CONTACT_FOOTER. getDocumentDesign() returns 'branded' unconditionally when import.meta.env.PROD.

company_settings_dev.address: Unit 301, Great Wall Bldg., 136 Yakal St., San Antonio Village, Makati City

hardcoded_in_pdf.address: Suite 400, 4/F Ermita Center Building, 1350 Roxas Boulevard, Ermita, Manila

findings.fair_reading: The hardcoded values are almost certainly correct for A Plus Falcons. The defect is not the address — it is that the branding is compiled in, the Settings page that appears to control it is decorative, and 96 saved per-document overrides are silently discarded.
findings.not_a_bug: The show_contact_footer toggle itself works correctly in both renderers.

findings.title: An invoice can print a six-figure TOTAL DUE with no line items and a zero subtotal
findings.cause: buildTotals() sources subtotal from the header and grandTotal from total_amount independently; the line table renders separately. No invariant relates them.

measured.rendered_output: table: 'No items on this invoice.' / Subtotal ₱0.00 / TOTAL DUE ₱120,000.00

findings.links_to: P2 — the same four Issued invoices that are invisible in every report.

findings.title: A printed invoice bills for a billing line that no longer exists
findings.cause: The invoice snapshots line items into metadata.line_items and is never reconciled against billing_line_items. A snapshotted line was deleted underneath it.
findings.mitigation_already_shipped: Migration 275 adds ON DELETE RESTRICT and a delete policy refusing invoiced lines, so this cannot recur. It does not detect the existing divergence, and no code path compares a snapshot to its source.
findings.links_to: M2, L2 — delete orphaning, now visible on a customer-facing document.

findings.title: The invoice resolver reads eleven columns that do not exist on invoices
findings.cause: Fields are read off the Invoice object that have no backing column; they survive only via the metadata.zone_a mirror.

measured.service_label_actually_printed: Service Charge (VAT) — NEU-058 grouped subtotals never show the real service

findings.latent: Terms only prints because zone_a.credit_terms duplicates invoices.payment_terms. Any edit path that does not rewrite zone_a leaves the document printing stale terms.

findings.title: show_letterhead is dead plumbing
findings.cause: Threaded through 8 files, typed in 3 interfaces, persisted to details.pdf_show_letterhead, copied into options.showLetterhead by both resolvers — read by neither renderer, applied by neither normalizePrintableDocument nor applyBrandedDesign, and present in no UI toggle list.

findings.title: Preview and PDF are not quite the same document

measured.pageFooterText: rendered by PrintableDocumentPdf, never by PrintableDocumentHtml

findings.title: The payslip is a mockup that prints

measured.print_button: window.print() — a payslip for a person who does not work here can be put on paper

findings.title: window.print() with no print stylesheet
findings.links_to: P1, P2, P3, P6 — the reports being printed here are the ones Wave 1 showed are wrong. The print button is how a wrong number becomes a filed document.

findings.title: The quotation FX conversion is skipped whenever an amount is stored
findings.cause: effectiveItemAmount() returns item.amount unmodified when it is non-zero, and applies forex_rate only on the fallback branch — so converted and original come out identical for any line carrying a stored amount.
findings.links_to: P8 — the same shape on the invoice side.

verdict: The document engine is the best-built subsystem QA has examined. Nothing here is a rendering bug. Every failure is at a seam: overwritten after normalization (Q1), an invariant nobody asserts (Q2), a snapshot nobody reconciles (Q3), a resolver reading names the table does not have (Q4), plumbing that goes nowhere (Q5, Q6), and a surface never wired up at all (Q7).
recommended_order: Q2 — a guard clause; refuse to render a total that its own lines do not support
Q3 — reconcile snapshot against billing_line_items, and warn on divergence
Q4 — mechanical, once someone decides whether zone_a or the columns are authoritative
Q1 — needs a product call: should Company Settings drive the documents, or stop pretending to?
Q7 — hide behind a flag until payroll exists
